schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) — { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A10 (D4-2)
definition: Fourth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before any promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Each entry pairs a non-native English production (vietlish) with its natural target (natural), the VN source pattern with diacritics (sourcePattern), and a contextual sentence. A few deliberate natural 'control' anchors are flagged in sourcePattern so reviewers can confirm the detector abstains on natural usage. Wave 4 focuses on grammar-interference families lighter in waves 1-2: conditionals, relative clauses, reported speech, gerund/infinitive, subject-verb agreement, do-support questions, causatives, possessive 'of', passives.
